title: StreamDQ: Near-Memory Weight DeQuantization in Custom HBM for Scalable AI Inference Acceleration
selection_reason: HBM base dieへ軽量dequantization blockを置き、GPU側CUDA coreでのweight dequantizationと余分なHBM trafficを除く。end-to-end LLM inferenceでlatency最大54.68%削減、decode throughput最大2.20倍を報告し、memory-side computeの実装比較として有用。
